==Notes==
*The special temporary skills given by the temporary Volfen Blessing equate to those of [[Volfen Blessing]] between rank 4 and 5; however, the mechanics of this skill itself are completely different because it was not changed along with Volfen Blessing.
*Equipping a weapon with a [[zealous]] mod will not alter the -2 energy degeneration, but you will benefit from its energy gain when hitting with an attack, which can help in maintaining Volfen Blessing.
